=========
XML body with json inside
=========

POST example.com

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
{
  "foo": "bar"
}

---

(document
  (section
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      body: (xml_body))))

=========
Raw body wrapped with annotation comments
=========

POST example.com

# @_RES
raw body
# @_END

---

(document
  (section
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      (metadata
        (generic_metadata
          name: (identifier)))
      body: (raw_body)
      (metadata
        (generic_metadata
          name: (identifier))))))

=========
JSON body wrapped with annotation comments
=========

POST example.com

# @_RES
{
  "foo": "bar"
}
# @_END

---

(document
  (section
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      (metadata
        (generic_metadata
          name: (identifier)))
      body: (json_body)
      (metadata
        (generic_metadata
          name: (identifier))))))

=========
Request with multiple external bodies
=========

POST example.com

< path/to/file


< path/to/file

---

(document
  (section
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      body: (external_body
        path: (path))
      body: (external_body
        path: (path)))))

=============================================
JSON line comment does not swallow next request
=============================================

POST https://example.com/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  // retained in the source, stripped before sending
  "access_token": "demo-token"
}

> {%
client.global.set("accessToken", response.body.access_token);
%}

### Consume token
# @ref login
POST https://example.com/consume
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "value": "ok"
}

---

(document
  (section
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      header: (header
        name: (header_entity)
        value: (value))
      body: (json_body)
      (res_handler_script
        (script
          body: (script_body)))))
  (section
    (request_separator
      value: (value))
    (metadata
      (ref_metadata
        name: (metadata_key)
        value: (value)))
    request: (request
      method: (method)
      url: (target_url)
      header: (header
        name: (header_entity)
        value: (value))
      body: (json_body))))
